result.reasoning: The fix commit "fixed some compilations issues and added more type information" completes generics/type parameterization that was incompletely introduced in commit eb0a9974753a ("HUGE change: ... did generic type inference"). That 2007 commit converted many raw types (List, HashMutableDirectedGraph, etc.) to partially-generic types (e.g., List<Object> instead of List<EquivalentValue>, raw HashMutableDirectedGraph), which caused the type-safety/compilation issues that commit 5aa5d814676c later corrects by properly parameterizing these same classes/fields (CallLocalityContext.nodes, ClassInfoFlowAnalysis.methodToInfoFlowSummary, InfoFlowAnalysis graph methods) with EquivalentValue. Git blame on the modified lines in the fix directly points to eb0a9974753a as the commit that established the incomplete/incorrect generic types being fixed.
